message: キャットファイトで盛り上げろ！

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. Turnout for the open-entry division isn't as good as I'd hoped.」

name: Ria
message: 「How many entries are there?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Five, including the hopeless Cake Shop Raiding Club.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's the Sweets Club! And the 'hopeless' part was totally uncalled for!」

name: Ria
message: 「Same as last year, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh. Is that right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... Last year, I figured it was just because it was the division's first time and nobody really knew about it.」

name: Misa
message: 「You are not to blame, Dear Sister. It couldn't be helped since it was the first time.」

name: Misa
message: 「However, the reason turnout is so poor this year is because the President is so hopeless!」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is a shame. It will be boring if things do not get lively.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And that's where we come in to liven things up!!」

name: Misa
message: 「I never thought you'd actually put together a proposal...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Didn't you egg me on yourself, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「I didn't think you would actually enter! Besides, a maid cafe at the sacred Holy Night Festival...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that?! Even a maid cafe can be sacred if we give it a sacred vibe!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it's not like there's any rule restricting the open-entry division to sacred events...」

name: Misa
message: 「Nobody goes out of their way to make rules for things anyone with common sense would know!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed. Things are getting quite heated. Having the Treasurer and the Vice President engage in a cat war should do the trick.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, wrong kind of heated, man. Besides, you mean a catfight.」

name: Synn
message: 「That 'common sense' is the exact reason nobody is signing up for the open-entry division!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah.」

name: Synn
message: 「There's a really high barrier to entry for participating in the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Misa
message: 「Even if you say that... it's basically an established convention of the Holy Night Festival, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, who decided that the Holy Night Festival has to be that way?」

name: Misa
message: 「Who...? Tradition, of course.」

name: Synn
message: 「I certainly think tradition is important. However, Ria-senpai created this division because she wanted more people to participate, didn't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... I see. Just creating an open-entry division wasn't enough.」

name: Synn
message: 「How about we try revamping it ourselves!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh!! That sounds super exciting!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In other words, the maid cafe won't stick out like a sore thumb anymore.」

name: Misa
message: 「But if we do that, won't it lose the essence of the Holy Night Festival?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course, we'll move forward while keeping the traditions intact.」

name: Ria
message: 「Does that mean the dance party too...」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course we're keeping it! No matter what anyone says!」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I see...」

name: Synn
message: 「Powering it up into an even better Holy Night Festival... Let's all come up with tons of new ideas to add to it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're quite greedy, Mr. President~~. Though I do agree with that idea.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. I think it's a good idea.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's a huge responsibility.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If we're gonna do this, success is the only option!」

name: Misa
message: 「Naturally.」

name: Synn
message: 「That being said, does anyone object to this plan to make the Holy Night Festival even livelier?」

name: Everyone
message: 「No objections!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, it's strange, isn't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「What is?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How did you manage to come up with the idea for a maid cafe, Treasurer?」

name: Synn
message: 「Though it looked like you were agonizing over it quite a bit until you decided.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm the kind of woman who transcends common sense when backed into a corner!」

name: Ria
message: 「Amazing.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, I figured it out! You're the easily influenced type, aren't you, Treasurer!」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The other day, there was a TV special on maid cafes.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I bet if they'd run a special on ramen stalls, you'd be running a ramen shop right now.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nuh-uh! It's 'cause Chocolat's uniform was cute, ya hear!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You really are the easily influenced type after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urk.」
